strongest_angle: The recall of 62,000 Toyota Tundra trucks is driven by a specific camshaft manufacturing defect rather than a fuel line issue, posing a risk of power loss at high speeds.

key_facts.fact: Toyota is recalling approximately 62,000 non-hybrid Tundra pickup trucks from model years 2022-2023 and 2025-2026 due to a camshaft defect.
Automotive World reports that while 62,000 vehicles are included in the recall, only about 300 camshafts from a single production lot are estimated to be faulty.
The camshaft defect in these Toyota Tundra trucks can cause the engine component to snap, potentially leading to a sudden loss of drive power while driving at high speeds.
